title: Design System: 城大搵食指南 CityU Eats

display.purpose: Hero headline only, one per page, TC serif 900.

headline.purpose: Section/category titles; EN grotesque label rides inline after.

label.purpose: EN caps labels, canteen codes, all numerals (tabular).

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Quote-card hover, band photo, floating layers.

shadows.name: ephemera-offset
shadows.purpose: Committed print ephemera: red seal and price stickers ONLY — the sole hard-offset shadows in the system.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: All transitions and animations; the system's only easing family.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll entrance; content visible by default, hidden class added by JS pre-paint only when IO and motion allowed.

motion.name: stamp-slam
motion.purpose: Randomizer result stamp; the page's single authored moment.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Red pill CTA — order actions, roll button, submit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; background: var(--red, #C93A1D); color: var(--butter, #FFF3DC); border:none; border-radius:999px; padding:12px 22px; font:600 15.5px/1.2 'Noto Sans TC',sans-serif; box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(43,26,14,.2); cursor:pointer; transition: transform .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--red-deep, #A32B12); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(43,26,14,.24); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2.5px solid var(--red-deep,#A32B12); outline-offset:2.5px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Butter pill for actions on the red hero field.
components.css: .ds-btn-butter { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; background: var(--butter, #FFF3DC); color: var(--ink, #2B1A0E); border:none; border-radius:999px; padding:12px 22px; font:600 15.5px/1.2 'Noto Sans TC',sans-serif; box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(43,26,14,.22); cursor:pointer; transition: transform .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .18s ease; } .ds-btn-butter:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(43,26,14,.26); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Category/scope filter pill with count; 44px touch target.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; border:1.5px solid rgba(43,26,14,.25); background:transparent; color:var(--ink,#2B1A0E); border-radius:999px; min-height:44px; padding:10px 16px; font:600 13.5px/1.2 'Noto Sans TC',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition: all .16s ease; } .ds-chip i { font:600 11.5px/1 'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif; font-style:normal; color:var(--muted,#6E5637); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--ink,#2B1A0E); } .ds-chip-on { background: var(--ink,#2B1A0E); border-color: var(--ink,#2B1A0E); color: var(--paper,#FBF2DF); } .ds-chip-on i { color: var(--yolk,#F2B21B); }

components.name: Verdict Stamp
components.description: The chop: verdict badges 必食/普通/避雷, rotated with double ring on 必食.
components.html: 必食 普通 避雷
components.css: .ds-stamp { display:inline-flex; padding:4px 11px; border-radius:8px; border:2.2px solid currentColor; font:700 13px/1.3 'Noto Sans TC',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; transform:rotate(-2.5deg); } .ds-stamp-must { color: var(--red,#C93A1D); background:rgba(201,58,29,.07); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(201,58,29,.28); } .ds-stamp-ok { color: var(--muted,#6E5637); background:rgba(110,86,55,.07); } .ds-stamp-avoid { color: var(--ink,#2B1A0E); background:rgba(43,26,14,.07); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(43,26,14,.3); }

components.name: Price Sticker
components.description: Egg-yolk price pill overlapping dish photos; one of two allowed hard-offset shadows.
components.css: .ds-price { display:inline-block; background: var(--yolk,#F2B21B); color: var(--ink,#2B1A0E); font:700 14px/1 'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; padding:6px 11px; border-radius:999px; transform:rotate(3deg); box-shadow:1.5px 2.5px 0 rgba(43,26,14,.25); }

components.name: Dish Card
components.description: Photo-first dish tile: strict 4:3 media, sticker, name, bilingual sub, stamp, rating.
components.html: 燒味雙拼飯Dual Roast Meat Rice4.2 ★★★★☆ 6則評論
components.css: .ds-dish { display:flex; flex-direction:column; background: var(--card,#FFFDF4); border:1.5px solid rgba(43,26,14,.25); border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; max-width:240px; transition: transform .22s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .22s ease; } .ds-dish:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(43,26,14,.13); } .ds-dish-media { position:relative; flex:none; min-height:0; aspect-ratio:4/3; background: var(--paper-2,#F5E8CC); } .ds-dish-body { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; padding:13px 15px 15px; } .ds-dish-name { font:700 15.5px/1.4 'Noto Sans TC',sans-serif; color:var(--ink,#2B1A0E); } .ds-dish-en { font:500 12px/1.4 'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif; color:var(--muted,#6E5637); } .ds-dish-rate { display:inline-flex; gap:7px; align-items:center; font-size:13.5px; color:var(--muted,#6E5637); } .ds-dish-rate b { font:700 15px/1 'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif; color:var(--ink,#2B1A0E); } .ds-dish-rate em { font-style:normal; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Review form input with red focus ring and red caret.
components.css: .ds-input { font:400 14.5px/1.6 'Noto Sans TC',sans-serif; color:var(--ink,#2B1A0E); background:var(--card,#FFFDF4); border:1.5px solid rgba(43,26,14,.25); border-radius:10px; padding:11px 13px; caret-color: var(--red,#C93A1D); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(43,26,14,.7); } .ds-input:focus { outline:none; border-color: var(--red,#C93A1D); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(201,58,29,.14); }

components.name: Canteen Code Chip
components.description: Canteen identity chip AC1/AC2/AC3, rotated −2°, per-canteen accent.
components.html: AC1 AC2 AC3
components.css: .ds-code { display:inline-block; font:800 13px/1 'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.1em; padding:6px 11px; border-radius:7px; transform:rotate(-2deg); } .ds-code-ac1 { background:#C93A1D; color:#FFF3DC; } .ds-code-ac2 { background:#DD9A08; color:#2B1A0E; } .ds-code-ac3 { background:#2E7D6B; color:#FFFDF4; }

narrative.northStar: 貼在飯堂門口的熱門食誌 — a zine pinned to the canteen door
narrative.overview: The system reads like a warm Hong Kong food zine that happens to be a utility: a butter-eggshell paper ground on which whole regions of saturated color do the talking — a full-bleed char-siu-tomato hero band, a soy-ink avoid-list panel, a dark ink footer. Verdicts are stamped like real chop marks, prices are egg-yolk stickers, and food photography is the protagonist everywhere else. Color commits at page scale: if a screenshot reads as cream-with-accents, the strategy has failed.
keyCharacteristics: Whole-region color fields on a warm paper ground
Chop/stamp verdict language: rotation + double ring
Egg-yolk stickers and Bricolage tabular numerals
Inline EN grotesque labels beside TC serif headings
One authored motion moment per view; exponential ease-out everywhere

rules.name: The Region-Field Rule
rules.body: Saturated color owns whole page regions; it is never reduced to scattered accents on naked ground.

rules.name: The Chop Rule
rules.body: A verdict is a stamp: 2.2px currentColor border + inset ring + −2.5° rotation. No plain pills for verdicts.

rules.name: The Warm-Gray Ban
rules.body: Secondary text tints from soy ink at opacities, never from gray.

rules.name: The Inline-Label Rule
rules.body: English labels sit inline after the Chinese heading at baseline; an eyebrow above a heading is a defect.

rules.name: The Tabular Price Rule
rules.body: Every repeating numeral is Bricolage with tabular figures.

dos: Do own whole regions with color — hero, avoid band and footer are fields, not accents
Do stamp verdicts and set numerals in Bricolage tabular figures
Do keep motion to one authored moment; ease out exponentially (cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))
Do tint secondary text from soy ink at 55–70%
donts: Don't put an English label above a Chinese heading
Don't use gray text or zero-blur offset shadows outside the seal/sticker exception
Don't fake material: no gradient text, no glass/blur decoration, no CSS bevels or faux-print textures
Don't give one canteen more visual authority than another
